description: Validates the consolidated design document summarizes (without duplicating) prior UI Prototyping outputs, stays consistent between Markdown and JSON, and has passed a handoff sanity check

checks.description: Consolidated design document (Markdown + JSON) must exist
checks.remediation: Run screen-assembledocument against screen-inventory.json, all layout-spec.md/mockup.html files, and interaction-flows.md

checks.description: Design document must not duplicate the full screen inventory listing or full Mermaid flow diagrams inline
checks.remediation: Per D-6/FR-08.1, summarize and link to screen-inventory.md and interaction-flows.md — do not re-embed their full per-screen listings or diagrams

checks.description: Design document must include an in-document changelog, even on first generation
checks.remediation: Add a Changelog section per R-610; first generation should still record a 'v1.0: Initial consolidated generation' entry

checks.description: Design document must link to (not replace) the standalone screen inventory and interaction flows documents
checks.remediation: Reference screen-inventory.md and interaction-flows.md via relative links rather than duplicating their content

checks.description: A handoff sanity check (readable by someone unfamiliar with the generating session) must have been performed, not merely assumed
checks.confirmation_statement: I read this design document as if I were a developer who was not present for the generating session, and confirmed it is understandable and actionable without that missing context
checks.remediation: Per TR-08.1, perform the handoff sanity check described in screen-assembledocument's own process and log it before marking this document complete

checks.description: Design Document ID should follow the DD-[###] convention
checks.remediation: Use the DD-[###] format from ui-prototyping-conventions.md
